newsitem.title: USA: Thomaston Mills sees loss for Q4 and FY97.
newsitem.headline: Thomaston Mills sees loss for Q4 and FY97.

text.p: Thomaston Mills Inc said Tuesday it expects a loss for the fourth quarter and the fiscal year ended June 28, and it is cutting its staff to 2,250 employees from 2,400 between now and December 31.
The company said it will make "every effort" to cut these positions through attrition where possible, and affected employees will be given first choice for new job openings.
The projected loss is a result of increased competition from imported textiles and apparel.
The company did not release loss amounts, since they are pending completion of the year-end audit.
The company said the situation has made it necessary for it to use "stringent cost control to remain competitive."
The company reported a loss of $0.57 per share for the nine months ended March 29, 1997.
